entries.title: Ezekiel 3:1
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:2
segments: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the roll.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:3
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:4
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:5
segments: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:6
segments: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, if I sent thee to them, they would hearken unto thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:7
segments: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are of hard forehead and of a stiff heart.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:8
segments: Behold, I have made thy face hard against their faces, and thy forehead hard against their foreheads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:9
segments: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:10
segments: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thy heart, and hear with thine ears.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:11
segments: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:12
segments: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, [saying], Blessed be the glory of Jehovah from his place.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:13
segments: And [I heard] the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:14
segments: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the hand of Jehovah was strong upon me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:15
segments: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river Chebar, and to where they dwelt; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:16
segments: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:17
segments: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:18
segments: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:19
segments: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:20
segments: Again, when a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:21
segments: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he took warning; and thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:22
segments: And the hand of Jehovah was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:23
segments: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of Jehovah stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:24
segments: Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet; and he spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thy house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:25
segments: But thou, son of man, behold, they shall lay bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:26
segments: and I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover; for they are a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:27
segments: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
